title: Adding a source config field: source.py fields, generated config and SOURCES.md must change together
answers: What files change when I implement a scaffolded warehouse source?
Do I edit generated_configs by hand?
Where do I register an implemented source in SOURCES.md?
body:
Implementing a previously scaffolded source touches several places together:
- Fields in source.py:get_source_config (SourceFieldInputConfig `api_key`, `table_ids`) must match the regenerated generated_configs/clay.py:ClaySourceConfig. The generated config is regenerated, not hand-edited.
- Drop `unreleasedSource=True` and set `releaseStatus=ReleaseStatus.ALPHA` to expose it.
- Move the source in SOURCES.md from the scaffolded list into the implemented table.
- Set `supported_versions`/`default_version`. The test_source_versions and test_source_categories invariants were run for this.
- Every HTTP call needs an explicit request timeout (clay uses REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=60 in both the sync client and validate_credentials).
applies: Implementing any scaffolded source under sources/<name>/
